title: Clarify criterion mapping refusals versus unreadable cited evidence
outcome: Clarify criterion mapping refusals versus unreadable cited evidence
acceptance: The criterion-links contract distinguishes unavailable or corrupt seal/run/completion binding refusals from unreadable cited evidence records, whose links remain with preview_error_class.

completion.summary: Distinguished native seal/run/completion binding refusals from retained cited-evidence links with preview_error_class.
